content.text: {"abstained":false,"abstention_reason":"","answer":"The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas (MOPNG) introduced and administers the Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0 scheme [E01][E02]. The ministry launched the scheme to provide free LPG connections to women from poor households [E01][E02], with the objective of making clean cooking fuel available to rural and deprived households that traditionally relied on firewood, coal, or cow-dung cakes [E02]. The ministry also provides cash assistance for PMUY connections, including security deposits, pressure regulators, LPG hoses, and domestic gas consumer cards [E01].","cited_evidence_ids":["E01","E02"],"claim_to_evidence":[{"claim":"The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas introduced and administers Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana 2.0","evidence_ids":["E01","E02"]},{"claim":"The scheme aims to provide free LPG connections to women from poor households","evidence_ids":["E01","E02"]},{"claim":"The ministry provides cash assistance for PMUY connections including security deposits, regulators, hoses, and consumer cards","evidence_ids":["E01"]}]}
